definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient is documented as taking antihypertensive medication from the pretreatment medical records, medication lists, or clinical history.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if antihypertensive medication use is not mentioned or is ambiguous.
definition.name: antihypertensive_use

definition.description: Presence of anxiety symptoms or a diagnosis of anxiety during the pretreatment period.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient record mentions the presence of anxiety in the psychiatric or psychosocial sections, or within the history of present illness. Any mention of anxiety, regardless of severity (e.g., 'mild anxiety', 'occasional anxiety'), is extracted as 'Present'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if there is no mention of anxiety in the provided clinical documentation.
definition.name: anxiety_present

definition.description: Whether the patient has a history of appendectomy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether an appendectomy is documented in the patient's past surgical history or medical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if not documented or explicitly denied.
definition.name: appendectomy_history

definition.description: The patient's reported or clinician-observed appetite status.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the appetite status from the clinical record. Map terms such as 'normal', 'stable', or 'resumed normal oral intake' to 'Normal'. Map terms such as 'decreased', 'loss of appetite', 'slightly decreased', or any reported severity/score for appetite loss (e.g., PRO-CTCAE or EORTC QLQ-C30 appetite loss scores > 0) to 'Decreased'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if appetite status is not documented.
definition.name: appetite_status

definition.description: Whether the patient has a documented history of exposure to asbestos.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract from the patient record (specifically occupational history, social history, or environmental exposure sections) whether there is any mention of exposure to asbestos.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if asbestos exposure is not mentioned or is documented ambiguously.
definition.name: asbestos_exposure_history

definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for AST (aspartate aminotransferase) from the pretreatment comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) or liver function tests.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the AST level is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: ast_level

definition.description: The daily dose of atorvastatin prescribed to the patient prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of the atorvastatin dose from the medication lists or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if atorvastatin is not mentioned or if the medication is listed without a specific dose.
definition.name: atorvastatin_dose

definition.description: Presence of atrial fibrillation in the patient's clinical history.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient has a documented history of atrial fibrillation from the medical history, surgical complications, cardiovascular physical examination findings (e.g., irregular rhythm), or medication indications (e.g., rate control for AFib).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'Absent' if there is no mention of atrial fibrillation in the record.
definition.name: atrial_fibrillation_presence

definition.description: The clinical status of a patient's hearing as determined by an audiogram.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the binary result of the audiogram (Normal vs. Abnormal/Impaired) from the pretreatment medical record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no audiogram status is documented or if the result is ambiguous.
definition.name: audiogram_status

definition.description: Presence of an abnormality in the axial structures.
definition.measurement_definition: Review clinical records for any mention of axial structure abnormalities. Extract 'Present' if an abnormality is documented; extract 'Absent' if the records explicitly state no abnormality or that axial structures are normal.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if axial structures are not mentioned or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: axial_structure_abnormality

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
